purpose: Separate and classify current and former Spanish counsel, procuradores, other professional advisers, historical owner/Community participants and later corporate/project officers without treating inclusion as an allegation.

included: Spanish legal professionals in the matter
other professional advisers and evidence custodians
excluded: proposal-only contacts mislabelled as retained counsel

boundaries: Inclusion is not an allegation or finding.
A lawyer's appearance does not establish authorship of every document, representation of every connected entity, firm-wide knowledge or professional fault.
Ownership, attendance, representation, voting or collective complaint naming does not prove individual intent or participation.
Current counsel are shown by verified professional name and minimal role only; private correspondence, fees, strategy and work allocation remain excluded.
Proposal-only, KYC-only, billing, collections and copied contacts remain separate from substantive retained counsel.
